faq.q: How fast do new listings sell in Chilliwack?
faq.a: From November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, the median was 26 days for Chilliwack houses, 29 for townhomes and 36 for condos.

faq.q: What price range sells the most houses in Chilliwack?

faq.q: How many Chilliwack houses sold this past year?

blocks.text: New listings in Chilliwack come on the MLS® every day, and this search shows the ones that have been on the market 7 days or less. How fast a fresh listing sells depends on its price and type. From November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, 294 Chilliwack houses sold in a median 26 days, 108 townhomes in 29 and 133 condos in 36.
Where Chilliwack house sales have been priced
The largest group of Chilliwack house sales, 110 of 294, closed in the $600,000 to $799,999 range, and 212 of 294 closed under $1,000,000. At the other end, 5 sold at $1,800,000 or more.

blocks.text: How fast new Chilliwack listings sell

A new listing’s first days matter most where homes sell quickly. Over the past year the fastest-selling Chilliwack groups (median days to sell, at least 10 sales) were Sardis South houses (19 days, 147 sales), Chilliwack Proper West townhomes (20 days, 18 sales), Sardis South townhomes (20 days, 43 sales). The slowest were Chilliwack Proper East condos (56 days), Sardis West Vedder houses (44 days), Sardis West Vedder townhomes (43 days).

blocks.text: Chilliwack house sales through the year
